scope: Next R1 generated graph dependency analysis; no new implementation admission
observations: Native ABI: graph destination R0, input cursor R1, returned advanced cursor R0. No length argument or boolean result.

Native constructs352 output bytes by ordered local-record copies. It has no whole-destination memset, no null/length/alignment guard and no consumed-count validation. The portable boolean API is not a native ABI replacement.

Seven aligned convolution records at offsets0x0c,0x2c,0x44,0x5c,0x8c,0xa4,0xbc; four nonaligned records at0x108,0x120,0x138,0xf0, in this order. Do not sort the final four calls by destination offset.
Helpers use hard-float S0 for scale and explicit stack arguments. Quantizer and pair helpers copy raw model words and advance cursor by8. Packed pool outputs8 bytes, operator outputs16.
Descriptor builders74aac/74b44 use unsigned full-width division before byte truncation; native graph supplies nonzero divisors. Native record-copy primitive2775c is already C memmove.

Next implementation should admit native graph and its helper contracts together, preserve cursor read/write timing and avoid importing portable guards or executable-address constants. Executor identities remain explicit unresolved data bindings until implementations exist.
